question: Can measured drug responses transfer to unmeasured immune-cell contexts?
outcome: Benchmark-provided log2 fold change versus DMSO across all 5317 supplied genes
training: Official train plus control labels: 306 profiles; controls are positive-control compounds
validation: Official public_test: 96 profiles; hyperparameters selected by mean profile RMSE
final_test: Official private_test: 151 profiles; no model selection or retuning using these labels
refit: Refit selected models on all 402 development profiles before final evaluation
pca_ridge_control: Same ridge alpha grid with training-only 24-component target PCA, added before any final-test scoring
primary_metric: Mean across condition profiles of gene-wise RMSE
secondary_metrics: Sign agreement on the observed top-50 absolute-effect genes
intervals: Paired bootstrap over drugs, not individual genes or cells; 2000 replicates
active_learning: Secondary offline study using development profiles only; fixed hidden evaluation set and a separate acquisition pool
boundaries: Processed benchmark outcomes include upstream joint preprocessing
Donor-aggregated outcomes do not test donor generalization
Known compounds and known cell types; new combinations only
No tissue geometry or mechanistic cell-cell signaling
Top-effect genes are not necessarily statistically significant genes
